items.description:
PostNet Cornwall View operates from Shop D2 in the Cornwall View Shopping Centre, on the corner of Boeing and Piering Streets in Elardus Park. The branch offers a broad range of print and copy services, including A4 and A3 printing, wide-format and plan printing, business cards, photo printing and name badges, alongside rubber stamp production. It also stocks convenience stationery and packaging material for customers preparing items to post or courier. As part of the PostNet network, the branch handles parcel courier services for local residents and businesses in the Elardus Park area, and also offers Vox website services.

The store trades Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 17:30 and Saturdays from 09:00 to 14:00, remaining open on public holidays from 08:30 to 13:00, while it is closed on Sundays.

PostNet Derdepark operates from the Derdepark Centre on Zambezi Avenue (Sefako Makgatho Drive) in Derdepoort, Pretoria. As part of the national PostNet network, the branch provides document printing and copying, courier drop-off and collection, and related business support services to customers in the surrounding Derdepoort area.

The store keeps extended weekday hours, trading Monday to Friday from 07:00 to 17:15, and also opens on Saturdays and public holidays from 08:00 to 13:00, while remaining closed on Sundays. Its position within the Derdepark Centre makes it a convenient stop for local residents and businesses needing printing, copying or parcel courier services as part of their daily errands in the area.

PostNet Silver Lakes operates from Shop 4 in the Hazeldean Square Shopping Centre, on the corner of Silver Lakes and Graham Roads in Pretoria East. The branch forms part of the national PostNet network, which combines courier services with printing, copying and digital business support such as internet access stations and fax-to-email facilities.

Customers can send and receive parcels through PostNet's domestic and international courier options, as well as handle everyday printing and copying needs. The store trades Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 18:00, Saturdays from 08:30 to 17:00, and Sundays and public holidays from 09:00 to 13:00, giving residents and businesses in the Hazeldean and Silver Lakes area extended access throughout the week.

Pretoria Noord Vleismark is a butchery in Wolmer offering a wide range of fresh beef, lamb and chicken cuts. Its staff provide guidance on selecting the right cuts for different cooking needs, and customers can shop in-store or arrange in-store pickup. Payment is accepted via NFC mobile payments as well as credit and debit cards, and the premises include a wheelchair-accessible entrance and parking.

The butchery is located at 605 President Steyn Street in Wolmer, Pretoria, where it serves the surrounding community with quality meat and a focus on service and convenience. Being based in Wolmer gives the butchery convenient reach to households and nearby businesses throughout Pretoria North looking for fresh meat and personal, knowledgeable service.

items.description:
Protege Power is a solar and renewable energy company based in Pretoria East, operating as a sister company of Protege Protection and sharing its values and standards. With more than eight years of experience in the solar power industry, the company designs and installs renewable energy systems using quality components while keeping client budgets in mind. Its team conducts site visits to take accurate measurements before installation, and offers both a residential solar calculator and commercial or industrial system assessments and proposals.

Protege Power places emphasis on after-sales support, maintaining systems once installed to keep them operating efficiently. While based in Pretoria East, the company operates across Gauteng and into neighbouring provinces, giving it reach well beyond its home base to serve clients needing reliable backup power as grid supply becomes less consistent.

Protec Energy Solutions has operated since 1994 and has grown into one of the largest private battery distributors in South Africa, supplying large companies, municipalities, government departments, spare parts shops and members of the public from its base in Derdepoort. The business specialises in automotive, motorcycle, deep-cycle, high-cycle, standby, reconditioned and solar batteries, and carries recognised brands including Protec Batteries, Willard Batteries and Sabat Batteries.

Where scheduling allows, the company offers free battery delivery, along with free battery testing and onsite battery installation for customers who need a battery fitted rather than simply purchased. Its focus spans both wholesale supply to businesses and retail sales to individual customers, giving it a broad customer base built up over three decades in the battery distribution trade in the Pretoria area.

Trading as Pretoria East Caravan Clinic, pta oos woonwa kliniek is a family-run caravan workshop that has operated since 2007. The business services and maintains caravans, carries out structural, body, interior, exterior and electrical repairs ranging from small fixes to major rebuilds, and undertakes layout conversions covering kitchens and sleeping spaces. It also offers customisation work such as added storage, air conditioning and other personal touches.

The workshop was started after its founders identified a need for reliable caravan service and workmanship, and it has continued to operate on a family basis since. Each caravan brought in is treated individually, with the work explained clearly to the owner before the vehicle is returned ready for the road. The business operates from the Mooiplaats area east of Pretoria.

Pure Diamond Tours runs guided day tours departing from Pretoria, including a half-day Pretoria City and Union Buildings tour priced from R1,300. The company also offers excursions further afield, such as a Rhino and Lion Park safari near Johannesburg lasting around nine hours and priced from R1,750, a four-to-seven hour visit to Lesedi Cultural Village from R1,600, and a ten-hour Pilanesberg National Park outing from R2,500. Its tour offering extends to the Cullinan Diamond Mine and other regional attractions, giving visitors based in or passing through Pretoria a range of day-trip options covering cultural, wildlife and historical sites across Gauteng and into neighbouring regions.

Tours generally last between four and ten hours depending on the destination chosen, and are booked directly through the company.

Quiche Me is an Annlin-based food business specialising in quiche, cakes and platters. Customers can shop in-store or choose curbside pickup, in-store pickup, or delivery for orders placed off-site, giving a flexible range of ways to collect food. The business accepts credit card payments and trades Monday to Saturday.

Based at the corner of Tillie van Wyk and Lavender Road East in Annlin, Quiche Me has built a following in the area for its quiche offering alongside cakes and platters suited to gatherings and everyday orders. Its combination of in-store service and delivery or pickup options makes it a convenient choice for customers across Annlin and the surrounding parts of Pretoria looking for a quick platter or baked treat.

items.description: Rateweb is a South African personal finance platform based in Monavoni, Centurion, that tracks live market data from the South African Reserve Bank, the currency market and the Johannesburg Stock Exchange to show how these feed into loan, deposit and insurance pricing. The site publishes a rate radar covering figures such as the top advertised savings rate and the prime-linked home loan rate, alongside a benchmarking tool that lets users compare their own savings rate, debt-to-income ratio and emergency fund size against South African medians. Beyond live rates, Rateweb publishes guides and articles on topics including life cover limits for children, medical scheme late-joiner penalties, workplace injury compensation, complaints processes against banks and insurers, and the history of South African interest rates, as well as practical guides to investing in rental property and building a balanced investment portfolio.

RHTM Business Solutions assists entrepreneurs, professionals and established companies with company formation and the ongoing statutory and regulatory compliance that follows it. The business works through a structured process, beginning with a consultation to understand a client's needs and recommend the appropriate registration or compliance service, followed by document submission and review, and finishing with registration and continued compliance support.

RHTM Business Solutions positions itself around expertise in South African business registration requirements, aiming to handle the administrative and legal processes so that clients can focus on growing their business. Its relationship with clients is intended to continue after registration is complete, with ongoing compliance and business maintenance support offered to keep a company's statutory affairs up to date over time.

Roamcode is a South African software and AI company offering a core set of technology services built around business outcomes. These include AI and intelligent automation for automating repetitive work, custom software development and APIs built around how a business operates, custom HR systems for leave, attendance and records management, and web and mobile application development. The company also provides cloud and DevOps services covering deployment, monitoring and scaling of infrastructure, along with business systems integration work that connects existing systems and modernises legacy applications.

Roamcode's engineers work across mainstream programming languages and frameworks spanning cloud, web, mobile and AI systems, serving clients both within South Africa and internationally from its base in Clydesdale, Pretoria.

Rostec Technical FET College's Pretoria campus is located on Pretorius Street, opposite the Tshwane Electricity Department. The campus holds Umalusi accreditation (No.

16 FET02 00069), is registered as a DHET examination centre (No. 89998835), carries QCTO accreditation (No. SDP 1220/16/0007) and is registered as a high school (No. 400444). It forms part of the wider Rostec college network and offers programmes spanning engineering, business courses, health sciences, National Certificate (Vocational) qualifications, and a high school stream. The combination of vocational and academic offerings allows the Pretoria campus to serve students pursuing both technical trade qualifications and standard high school completion, with the accreditation and registration numbers providing formal recognition for its engineering, business and health sciences programmes.

RPS Property Solutions provides solar, electrical and property services for homes and businesses from its base in Raslouw, Centurion. The company designs and installs solar systems intended to help clients reduce their reliance on grid power and lower electricity costs during load shedding. It also carries out emergency electrical repairs, with qualified electricians responding to power outages and electrical faults to restore supply safely.

RPS Property Solutions is fully licensed and registered to issue electrical Certificates of Compliance, which are required for property sales, renovations and general safety inspections. Its combination of solar installation and electrical repair work means it can both install new backup power systems and handle the electrical certification and fault-finding work that often accompanies property transactions or upgrades in the Centurion area.

Salvagente supplies ozone therapy and wellness equipment from Waterkloof Glen, Pretoria, with a product range that includes ozone steam saunas sized for both spa or salon use and personal home use. Alongside its sauna range, the company sells ozone insufflation kits, oxygen concentrators and a selection of ozone-based health and beauty products.

Salvagente positions its offering around natural, renewable and non-invasive therapies intended to support general wellness, and provides buyer's guides and training material to help clinics, spas, salons and individual customers choose and use the equipment. The business serves both commercial wellness operators looking to add ozone therapy to their treatment offering and individual customers purchasing saunas or related equipment for home use.

Save My Bacon is an IT services provider based in Constantia Park, Pretoria, offering web hosting, VPS hosting and custom hosting alongside managed IT support. Its services extend to VoIP and technical support backed by service level agreements, as well as network and connectivity solutions for business communications.

The company's team brings experience in networking, IT security, virtual infrastructure and cloud solutions, positioning it to support businesses needing reliable connectivity and communication systems rather than a single product offering. Save My Bacon markets itself on reliability and a broad range of services, from internet connectivity and cloud-based communication tools through to ongoing managed support, aiming to minimise downtime for client businesses that depend on continuous connectivity and voice services.

Secrets For Business Growth, based in Rooihuiskraal, Centurion, offers a coaching service called Flash Coaching, delivered through its Ubequity Coaching & Mentoring arm. Flash Coaching sessions are structured as short, twenty-minute calls aimed at helping entrepreneurs and professionals move past a single stuck point using a simple framework of one challenge, one call, one idea and one action step.

Clients can try a single Flash Coaching session before committing further, or subscribe to a monthly plan that includes two sessions per month along with priority booking access. The service is aimed at ambitious, action-oriented business owners who want focused input on a specific decision or obstacle rather than a lengthy coaching programme, giving them a fast way to gain clarity and leave each call with a practical next step.

ShelvCraft (Pty) Ltd is a mass manufacturer of industrial and commercial shelving, racking and display systems, based in Sunderland Ridge, Pretoria, with more than 40 years in the industry. The company's product range covers bolt-and-nut shelving, gondola shelving and wallbands, racking from light to heavy duty including cantilever and mole racking, as well as checkout counters, barriers, baskets, checkout chairs, trolleys and turnstiles. It also manufactures customised display units in wood, glass, aluminium, metal and wire, and offers shopfitting services alongside its shelving products.

ShelvCraft provides design advisory, manufacturing and installation services, and its customer base spans hardware stores, supermarkets, pharmacies, clothing retailers and warehousing operations, reflecting its position as a long-established supplier across multiple retail and storage sectors.

Shuttle South Africa, based in Jan Niemand Park, positions itself as a reliable alternative to e-hailing and rideshare services for airport and point-to-point transport. The company offers both shared ride and private shuttle options for airport transfers, along with an hourly car service for customers who need a driver on standby or are unsure of their exact schedule. Rates are quoted upfront, with the company stating there are no hidden fees once a booking is confirmed.

Its vehicles are stocked with small extras such as free water, mints, phone chargers, newspapers and magazines for passengers during a trip. Shuttle South Africa operates on an on-call basis around the clock, tailoring routes and timing to individual requirements rather than running on fixed schedules alone, which suits both leisure travellers and corporate clients needing flexible transport.

Simply Asia is a Thai restaurant chain that has operated in South Africa for over 20 years and now spans more than 50 stores across the Western Cape, Gauteng, KwaZulu-Natal and Zambia, including its branch in the Waterkloof area at Brooklyn Design Square. Its chefs are trained by experienced Thai chefs in the techniques behind the cuisine, and the restaurant uses ingredients imported directly from Thailand alongside signature sauces produced in the company's own South African factory. The menu covers noodle dishes, curries and ramen, with spice levels ranging from mild to extra hot, as well as vegetarian and vegan options and dishes prepared without chilli for customers who prefer milder flavours.

This branch offers both dine-in and takeaway service for customers in the Brooklyn and Waterkloof area of Pretoria.

Simpology Group, based in Val de Grace, Pretoria, designs, develops, implements and supports software solutions for operational and business management environments, with a client base spanning mining, metals, petrochemical and financial services companies in South Africa and Namibia. Its core product line is built around the SIMSAFE brand, covering digital key management, digital lock-out and tag-out systems, vehicle management, and smart lockers, aimed at improving safety and accountability on industrial and mining sites.

Beyond these safety systems, Simpology Group also offers ITIL-based service management, project and programme management, and technology innovation and acceleration services. The company's focus on digital safety tools for underground and industrial mining operations reflects its positioning as a specialist technology partner for sectors where equipment tracking and controlled access are critical to day-to-day safety.

Snyman de Jager Attorneys has practised since 1938 and operates four branches across Gauteng and the Western Cape, including its branch in Midstream. The firm's practice areas cover property and conveyancing, handling transfers, bonds and registrations from offer through to registration; litigation, providing advice and representation in disputes; estates, wills and trusts, covering the administration and protection of client estates; and notarial and general practice work, including contracts and notarial deeds. Operating from Bondev Office Park in Midstream, the branch forms part of a firm with a long-standing presence in property law, drawing on nearly nine decades of combined experience across its branch network to support clients with property transactions, estate planning and related legal matters in the Midstream and wider Centurion area.

Social Excellence is a full-service marketing agency based in Murrayfield, Pretoria, offering web design and development that includes UI/UX design, SEO, responsive design and ongoing web maintenance. The agency also provides graphic design and printing services covering brochures, banners, company profiles and other printed collateral, along with social media management spanning content creation, content calendars, customer engagement and paid advertising. Additional services include photography and videography for product and marketing use, and brand identity development covering logo design, brand core development, corporate identity and packaging design.

Its project portfolio includes website design and development work for clients such as My Hungry Husband and Student At Home, and branding and web design work for BukhoBuhle Architects, illustrating the agency's combined focus on digital, print and brand identity projects for a range of business clients.

Solvendi specialises in sequestration, liquidation and broader insolvency services from its base in Southdowns, Centurion. The firm assists clients with sequestration, a voluntary debt solution that allows individuals who are genuinely unable to meet their unsecured debt to have it written off and rebuild their financial position, as well as company liquidation, bankruptcy proceedings and credit rehabilitation services.

Solvendi's stated aim is to help clients reach their financial objectives as smoothly and cost-effectively as possible, combining knowledge of insolvency law with an understanding of the local market and each client's personal or business circumstances. The firm's focus spans both personal and business insolvency matters, giving it a role at different stages of a client's financial difficulty, from initial advice through to the formal legal processes required to resolve unsecured debt.

SourcePrinting supplies signage, branding equipment and printing machines to customers across South Africa and the wider African continent, from its base in Wolmer, Pretoria. Its product range includes sublimation and vinyl cutting bundles, direct-to-film (DTF) printers in several sizes, large-format signage printing combinations pairing eco-solvent printers with vinyl cutters, dye sublimation production bundles, and UV flatbed and UV DTF printing machines.

The company also offers grouped equipment bundles aimed at customers looking to start or expand a print production business, combining multiple machine types into a single purchase. Alongside hardware sales, SourcePrinting provides printing supplies, consumables and equipment training, positioning itself to support both small operators setting up a sign or print shop and larger commercial signage projects that require higher-volume equipment.

Southpole Freight and Logistics handles the clearing and forwarding of sea and air cargo, as well as road transport and distribution of cargo across the Southern African region, from its base in Pretoria West. The company works with containerised and groupage cargo alongside loose cargo and small parcels, giving it flexibility across different shipment sizes.

Its operations team is made up of former customs officers and staff with established backgrounds in the shipping industry, which the company positions as a measure for maintaining high service standards in customs clearance and cargo handling. Southpole Freight and Logistics states its aim as providing globally competitive cargo management, supporting clients who need import and export shipments cleared and moved efficiently through the Southern African logistics network rather than only within South Africa's borders.

Spaza is a creative technology agency based in The Willows, Pretoria, that has helped secure more than R54 million in investment for its clients and completed more than 27 app and web development projects. Its portfolio includes the app for Umvuzo Health, a tailored insurance scheme, and an app for Dynamic Diesel Deliveries covering diesel delivery and generator services across South Africa.

Other projects include Gynaeworx, a tool for women to track and manage reproductive health, Rocket, an app for an independent emergency medical services provider offering 24/7 air and road assistance, and XRPayNet and Volta Wallet, both cryptocurrency-related payment and portfolio applications. Spaza also built SoundSafe, an app aimed at creating a calmer, safer environment for horses and riders, and an app for Safari Outdoor connecting outdoor enthusiasts to share experiences and advice, reflecting a varied portfolio spanning health, logistics, finance and lifestyle sectors.

Spec-Savers Waterkloof Ridge has operated from Shop 15 in the Waterkloof Ridge Lifestyle Centre on Cliff Avenue since opening in September 2001. The practice runs a single testing room equipped with a fundus camera, tonometer and autorefractor, used for eye examinations and hearing tests. It is staffed by five team members, including a permanent optometrist supported by a locum optometrist on some afternoons.

The practice emphasises understanding each patient's individual needs and expectations as part of its approach to eye and hearing care. It trades Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 18:00 and Saturdays from 09:00 to 13:00, remaining closed on Sundays and public holidays, giving patients in the Waterkloof Ridge area access to optometry and audiology services with specialised diagnostic equipment on site.

Spektra Financial Services, based in Magalieskruin, provides holistic financial planning aimed at helping clients build wealth while aligning their plan with their personal values and life goals. Its service range covers investment planning, retirement planning and offshore investments, alongside advice on medical aid selection, individual risk planning and group risk cover for businesses.

The firm positions its approach as integrating the different facets of a client's life and financial objectives into a single plan, rather than addressing products in isolation. Spektra Financial Services works with individual clients on personal financial goals such as retirement and investment growth, as well as supporting group risk cover arrangements that extend its advisory services to organisations and their employees in the Magalieskruin area and beyond.

Stone Sensation supplies paving, cladding and stone products from its base in Donkerhoek, delivering to customers across Gauteng and further afield. Its product range covers pool and patio paving tiles, commercial paving, driveway paving, wall cladding and floor or roof tiles, along with garden landscaping stones, rocks, pebbles and decorative garden items. The company also undertakes custom stone work for residential and commercial projects, and offers simulated paving options alongside its natural stone range.

Stone Sensation markets its products as eco-friendly, aiming to meet sustainability and durability standards while remaining affordable, and counts architects, landscapers and homeowners among its customers. The breadth of its catalogue, spanning pools and patios through to driveways and commercial paving, allows it to serve both small garden projects and larger commercial paving contracts from one supplier.

items.description:
Tawny Creek Spur is a family-friendly restaurant operating under the Spur Steak Ranches brand from Shop 2 in the Northdale Shopping Centre, on the corner of Rachel De Beer and Grafenheim Streets in Ninapark, Pretoria North. The restaurant serves the standard Spur menu of steaks, ribs and burgers, alongside desserts, and caters for a range of dietary preferences with food types spanning steakhouse and grill dishes, vegetarian and vegan options.

As part of the national Spur chain, the branch follows the group's family-oriented dining format, making it a regular option for families in the Ninapark and wider Akasia area looking for a casual sit-down meal. Its location within the Northdale Shopping Centre places it alongside other retail and dining options, giving visitors the ability to combine a meal with other errands in the same centre.

Taypim Group (Pty) Ltd provides construction services from its base on Saal Street in Zwavelpoort, working with customers through the construction process from planning to completion. The company carries out renovations, additions, alterations and new home construction, and also sells Kerakoll waterproofing products, finishing coats, screeds and binders, and self-levelling screed compounds, alongside premix bags for general building use. Its combination of contracting work and building material sales allows it to supply products directly for projects it manages as well as for other builders and homeowners purchasing materials separately.

The business trades Monday to Thursday from 07:30 to 16:30 and Fridays from 07:30 to 14:00. Its focus on Kerakoll waterproofing and screed products, alongside general renovation and new-build construction, positions it as both a contractor and a materials supplier for the Zwavelpoort and wider Pretoria East area.

Tender Capital Africa is a 100% woman- and black-owned financial inclusion enterprise based in Faerie Glen, Pretoria, that provides tender funding to micro, small and medium enterprises. The company's stated aim is to remove financial barriers that often prevent smaller businesses from entering mainstream economic opportunities, by equipping them with financing tools suited to taking on tender work. According to its own figures, Tender Capital Africa has funded 303 projects to a total value of over R145.3 million.

Its funding model is built specifically around tender opportunities, helping businesses that have secured a tender but need working capital to deliver on it, rather than offering general-purpose business loans. This focus on tender-specific financing, combined with its ownership structure, positions the company within South Africa's broader push to expand access to finance for historically underfunded business owners.

items.description:
The Tax Shop Franchise Head Office, based in Lynnwood Glen, Pretoria, operates as the franchise support arm of the Tax Shop accounting brand. Its stated mission is to make clients' financial lives easier through accounting, payroll, tax and related professional services delivered by its franchised practices.

On the franchise side, the head office supports accountants who want to build their own accounting and tax practices under the Tax Shop name, offering a franchise model along with a dedicated franchise login portal for existing franchisees. This dual focus means the head office both promotes the Tax Shop service offering to end clients and manages the franchise relationships that allow individual accountants to set up and run their own Tax Shop-branded practices across the country.

TOPS at SPAR Kloofsig is a liquor store on Kruger Avenue at the corner of Theodore Street in Kloofsig, operating alongside the adjoining SPAR supermarket. As a TOPS outlet, it stocks wine, spirits and beer for customers shopping at the centre.

The store keeps extended trading hours, open Monday to Saturday from 08:00 to 20:00 and Sundays from 09:00 to 15:30, giving customers access to liquor purchases across most of the week including weekend afternoons. Its position next to the SPAR supermarket makes it a convenient stop for customers doing a weekly grocery shop who also want to pick up wine, spirits or beer in the same visit, serving households in the Kloofsig area of Centurion.

TrenStar operates a depot in Rosslyn as part of its returnable packaging and pooled container network, supplying supply-chain logistics solutions to industry. The company's offering combines returnable packaging equipment with technology and service, applying RFID, barcoding, GPS and sensor technology to give clients real-time visibility and traceability of assets moving through their supply chain. TrenStar's services span professional strategy, analysis, development and implementation support, a control centre for monitoring and managing exceptions and alerts, and onsite services at client locations.

On the packaging side, the company manages and pools returnable packaging equipment, maintaining and conditioning it between uses and handling the design of equipment suited to specific client needs. Its Rosslyn depot forms part of this packaging pooling network, serving clients in the surrounding Akasia and greater Pretoria area who need supply-chain visibility and reduced manual stock handling.

Trulyhealth, based in Clubview, Centurion, sells ice bath systems designed for cold water immersion and recovery. The company markets its ice baths around claimed benefits including reduced muscle soreness and inflammation, improved circulation and immune function, better sleep and mood, and increased mental resilience through regular cold exposure. Alongside its ice bath range, Trulyhealth sells eyewear under its TrulyBlue brand, including blue-light-blocking glasses aimed at reducing digital eye strain during screen-heavy work or reading, and polarised sunglasses offering full UV protection for outdoor use.

Both product lines are sold through the company's online store, which operates as part of the wider TrulyGroup. This combination of recovery equipment and protective eyewear positions Trulyhealth within the broader wellness and self-care retail space, targeting customers looking to build cold therapy or eye protection into their daily routines.
